hero.name: Pablo Chahin
hero.bio: I am a creative advertising content creator, trained in Buenos Aires, Argentina, and currently based in Barcelona. I particularly enjoy the creative development phase, from bringing ideas to life through photography and video to the design process itself. I truly like doing things differently, even if it sounds cliché and it's not always easy to achieve.

intro.text: This space brings together projects and processes where creativity is thought, tested, and built. Each piece is born from a search for conceptual meaning, taking care of both the idea and its execution. What you see here is the result of intention, criteria, and perspective.

stories.title: When Coffee Meets Ritual
stories.text: A fleeting encounter where coffee meets pastry and matcha. This video captures the rhythm, textures, and atmosphere of a pop-up conceived as an experience, focusing on details and turning everyday gestures into meaningful moments.

stories.title: Built From Within
stories.text: More than a gym, an idea. This manifesto translates MOV's energy, discipline, and mindset into direct, raw images with clear intention. Movement, strength, and purpose told from what truly matters.

stories.title: A Glimpse of What's Coming
stories.text: A teaser that doesn't explain, it suggests. This piece introduces Amani's universe through rhythm, atmosphere, and attitude, leaving room for interpretation and building anticipation through visuals.

stories.title: The Calm Before the Move
stories.text: A teaser that anticipates without revealing. Tension, controlled pauses, and a contained narrative prepare the ground for what's coming, reinforcing MOV's identity and character through emotion.

statement.text: Visuals are just the surface. Meaning goes deeper.

closingStories.title: A Place With Its Own Rhythm
closingStories.text: EL VILLA is built around connection, ritual, and unhurried enjoyment. This video reflects that spirit, capturing moments that define its identity: pause, conversation, and a distinctive way of inhabiting the space.

closingStories.title: Trust as a Core Value
closingStories.text: Beyond technology, Tecno-key is about trust. This project focuses on the idea of protection as part of everyday life, building a narrative that communicates solidity, control, and peace of mind through the brand.

closingStories.title: When Brands Speak in Their Own Voice
closingStories.text: The interview as a tool to build identity. A format where the brand expresses itself from a human perspective, reinforcing values, tone, and vision through words and presence.
